name: Sonix
author: 3dthc
summary: A melodic ROMpler instrument for standalone Akai MPC devices, built as a native ARM VST2 plugin. Includes pianos, keys, pads, strings, brass, choirs, leads, plucks, bass, bells, synth chords and effects, using redistributable sound libraries. Also a VST3 for Mac and Windows and an Audio Unit for Mac.
